cases.setup: An available local workspace different from the current selection
The current workspace has one existing unread attention chat

executionContract: Exercise the actual production row event handler, not a duplicated predicate or static regex as a behavior substitute.
Keep every expected value identical before and after any future product patch.
Attribute blocked-case baseline failures to actual selection/chat callback activity, not setup/import/navigation failures.
The ordinary primary controls must pass on baseline and candidate.
A non-primary event must reach the real production callback to test its guard. A browser not delivering a click for that button is not a passing guard check.
Do not infer anchor default navigation, popup behavior, macOS WebKit parity or native acceptance from these cases.
scopeStatus: Source qualification only. No product lease or runtime admission.
